summary.one_liner: LLMStack is a no-code platform for building generative AI agents, workflows, and chatbots that chain multiple LLMs and connect to your own data and business processes.
summary.what_it_does: LLMStack provides a no-code builder for chaining multiple LLMs into AI apps, agents, and chatbots without writing code. It can import data such as CSV, TXT, PDF, DOCX, and PPTX from sources like Google Drive, Notion, websites, and direct uploads, then preprocesses and vectorizes it into a built-in vector database. Built apps and chatbots can be accessed over an HTTP API and triggered from Slack or Discord. The README also describes multi-tenant organizations with per-organization data isolation and an admin panel for managing users. It can be installed via pip and run locally or deployed to the cloud or on-premise.
use_cases: chatbot trained on your own documents
chain multiple LLMs into an app
trigger AI workflows from Slack or Discord
generate sales emails and research reports
how_to_run: Open localhost:3000 (opens automatically) and log in with the default admin account, then change the password
Optionally add provider API keys in the Settings page or in ~/.llmstack/config
Install Docker if you want to use background jobs
notable: No-code builder for chaining multiple LLMs into AI apps
Built-in data ingestion and vector database for uploaded or connected documents
Apps can be triggered from Slack or Discord and called over HTTP
Available as a hosted cloud offering at Promptly or self-hosted
caveats: Running jobs requires Docker to be installed
On Windows, it must be installed inside WSL2
Default admin credentials are set and should be changed after first login
